title: Adapted Law Invariance and Time-Consistent Dynamic Risk Measures
abstract: arXiv:2607.04392v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: In static risk measurement, law invariance expresses the principle that the risk of a position should depend only on its distribution, and not on the particular probability space on which it is represented. In a dynamic setting, the same principle leads naturally to adapted law invariance: the risk assessment should depend only on the probabilistic structure of the financial position together with the way information about it is revealed over time. We show that, for time-consistent risk measures, adapted law invariance is equivalent to a recursive one-step conditional-law representation. More precisely, assuming Fatou regularity, the one-step risk evaluations are exactly conditional lifts of static law-invariant risk measures, and the full dynamic risk measure is obtained by backward composition of these one-step maps. translated_title: 适应性法律不变性与时间一致的动态风险度量
translated_abstract: 在静态风险度量中，法律不变性表达了这样一个原则：头寸的风险应仅取决于其分布，而非其所在特定概率空间。在动态环境中，同一原则自然引出了适应性法律不变性：风险评估应仅取决于金融头寸的概率结构，以及关于其信息随时间揭示的方式。我们表明，对于时间一致的风险度量，适应性法律不变性等价于一种递归的一步条件法律表示。更精确地说，假设法图正则性，一步风险评估恰好是静态法律不变风险度量的条件提升，而完整的动态风险度量通过向后组合这些一步映射获得。动态风险度量的凸性和一致性由其对应的静态性质所刻画。
tldr: 本文证明时间一致动态风险度量的适应性法律不变性可等价为递归一步条件法律表示，并刻画其凸性与一致性。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that adapted law invariance for time-consistent dynamic risk measures is equivalent to a recursive one-step conditional-law representation, characterizing convexity and coherence.
